experience: A compact east-bank paper shop where blank reams from the opposite workshop become stitched books in view of the stone street and canal.
hero_read: open two-bay shopfront, warm counter, pale paper stacks, wall shelves and a grounded four-foot binding press
circulation: east stone street remains continuous past the shop
two short bluestone thresholds lead from street to the open west frontage
two front bays keep counter sales and binding work visually distinct
rear shelves remain legible without becoming a false doorway
style_guardrails: restrained Ming timber frame with real post-shoe-beam contacts
white plaster, dark roof, warm wood, bluestone and paper-white accents
small trade building remains subordinate to the west-bank production shed
shared low-polygon paper and book meshes; no new bitmap textures
